_about: Resource budget of a SLAM replay (tools/slam_budget.py), checked after every scored run of replay_slam_bag.sh.
Limits sit well above the measured defaults of 2026-11-01 (label round6: one lap of apollo16_stereo3_lap1, 12 hardware
threads, no RViz): all SLAM processes 146 % CPU and 1.7 GB, the backend 63 %, DLIO 42 ms CPU per scan, hazard updates
58 ms mean / 103 ms p95 with no dropped scan, GICP 4.9 ms. Only a real regression trips them; slam_compare.py is the finer judge.
Keys are dotted paths into metrics.json; a key the run lacks (no hazard block with --no-hazard) is n/a, not a failure.
